requirement.description: The View.__getitem__ method has incorrect error handling for missing field access. It raises AttributeError with incorrect message format, and doesn't properly handle reserved field names.
requirement.contract: When accessing a non-existent field via __getitem__ or __getattr__, the View class should raise AttributeError with a properly formatted message that includes suggestions for similar field names. Additionally, accessing reserved field names (starting with underscore) should raise AttributeError with a specific message indicating they can only be accessed by indexing.

requirement.description: The View.__getitem__ method incorrectly handles array layout indexing with non-Value types. It should raise TypeError with specific message when trying to index array layout with non-Value types.
requirement.contract: When a View with ArrayLayout is indexed with a non-Value type, the __getitem__ method should raise TypeError with message "Only views with array layout, not {layout_type}, may be indexed with a value".

requirement.description: The Layout.of method is not properly implemented. It tries to access a private attribute that doesn't exist in the current implementation.
requirement.contract: The Layout.of method should return the layout from a view object by accessing the appropriate internal attribute (likely __orig_layout).

requirement.description: The View.__init__ method doesn't properly handle layout conflicts with class attributes. The conflict checking logic is incomplete and doesn't match the expected warning format.
requirement.contract: The View.__init__ method should properly detect and warn about field names that conflict with class attributes, using the exact format expected by tests.

requirement.description: Enum class has incorrect error message formatting for shape mismatch warnings. The error messages don't match the expected format exactly.
requirement.contract: The EnumMeta class should produce error messages with exact format matching the test expectations, including proper escaping of special characters.
